verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with documented telephony support (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, SIP, PSTN), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. The general carrier and webhook telephony evidence does not show these specific capabilities.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
